A.P. Moller - Maersk reported a return on invested capital (ROIC) of 12.3% for the group in 2024, which was above the yearly target of above 7.5%. The ROIC is calculated as profit/loss before financial items for the year (EBIT) less tax on EBIT divided by the average invested capital over the last twelve months.

The 12.3% ROIC figure for 2024 is stated in the "Five-year summary" under financial ratios [5] and confirmed in the "Quarterly summary" for Q4 2024 [4]. This exceeded the stated yearly target of >7.5%, as noted in the "Roadmap towards 2025" section [1]. The definition of ROIC is provided in the "Definition of terms" section, specifying it as EBIT less tax on EBIT divided by average invested capital (last twelve months) [6].

ArcelorMittal reported a group-wide Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) of 0.70 for 2024.  
The company defines LTIFR as Lost Time Injuries (LTI) per 1,000,000 worked hours, including both own personnel and contractors.  
A lost time injury is defined as an incident that causes an injury preventing the person from returning to their next scheduled shift or work period.  
These definitions are provided in the Glossary of the ArcelorMittal Annual Report 2024 [5].  
The LTIFR value of 0.70 for 2024 is stated in the Sustainable Development section of the same report [3].

Maersk's seafarer population totals more than 12,000 employees. The total workforce across all countries is approximately 55,007 (sum of employees in India, Denmark, China, and USA from the report). Based on this, seafarers make up roughly 22% of Maersk's workforce at the end of 2024.

Lerøy's wild-catch volume fell by 10,902 tonnes in 2024, and the company says the outlook for that business remains challenging due to low quotas.

- In 2023, Lerøy Havfisk had a catch volume of 75,893 tonnes [1].
- In 2024, the catch volume was 64,991 tonnes [1].
- The decrease is therefore 75,893 – 64,991 = 10,902 tonnes [1].
- This decline reflects significant year-on-year reductions in cod and haddock quotas, down 34% and 43% respectively [1].
- Earnings in the WildCatch segment have been significantly affected by the low quota basis [5].
- The company expects 2025 and probably also 2026 to be challenging for this segment [5].
